text_blocks.snippet: Photosynthesis is the process where plants, algae, and some bacteria turn sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into food and oxygen .
snippet_highlighted_words: the process where plants, algae, and some bacteria turn sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into food and oxygen

text_blocks.snippet: The word comes from "photo," meaning light, and "synthesis," meaning putting together. You can learn more about the foundations of this process from the Smithsonian Science Education Center .

references.title: What is Photosynthesis | Smithsonian Science Education Center
